# Standard Tech Impianti

> > Industrial refrigeration and cleanroom specialist offering CO2/natural refrigerant systems, cold storage facilities, and turnkey solutions for food processing and pharmaceutical industries.

Standard Tech Impianti designs and installs energy-efficient refrigeration systems using natural refrigerants (CO2 R744, ammonia R717) and pharmaceutical-grade cleanrooms compliant with ISO 14644-1. The company serves dairy, meat processing, bakery, logistics, and pharmaceutical sectors across Italy and international markets including Dubai.

## Key Topics

- CO2 refrigeration (R744)
- Natural refrigerants (NH3, propane, isobutane)
- Industrial cold storage
- Pharmaceutical cleanrooms (ISO 14644-1)
- Cheese aging rooms
- Energy efficiency
- Food processing systems
- Turnkey solutions
- ECOFREDDO technology
- BioxTech systems
- STERILTECH cleanrooms
- Distribution platforms
- Cured meat aging
- Bakery processing
- HFC alternatives

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Turnkey Services](https://standard-tech.it/en/services): Turnkey industrial refrigeration & cleanroom services for food & pharma
- [Industrial Cold Storage Warehouses](https://standard-tech.it/prodotti/magazzini-refrigerati): Industrial cold storage warehouses for logistics and distribution
- [Storage Centers and Distribution Platforms](https://standard-tech.it/en/settori/storage-centers-and-distribution-platforms): CO2 refrigeration for storage centers & distribution platforms sector
- [Pharmaceutical Cleanrooms](https://standard-tech.it/industrie/industria-farmaceutica): Pharmaceutical cleanrooms with STERILTECH & ISO 14644-1 compliance
- [Cured Meat & Prosciutto Aging Rooms](https://standard-tech.it/prodotti/celle-di-stagionatura-della-carne): Cured meat & prosciutto aging rooms with ECOFREDDO refrigeration systems
- [Bakery Processing Systems](https://standard-tech.it/prodotti/impianti-di-lavorazione-di-prodotti-da-forno): Bakery processing systems with cleanrooms & BRC/ISO/IFS compliance
